teenKit.tldr: This episode explores whether human consciousness is powered by quantum-gravitational spacetime ripples inside brain cell structures or by standard chemical signaling across synapses. We pit Roger Penrose and Stuart Hameroff’s radical Orch-OR theory against devastating modern physical and biological counter-evidence.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding how anesthetics instantly switch off your subjective existence could unlock the deepest physical secrets of what makes you, you.
keyTakeaways: Orch-OR proposes that quantum state collapses inside tiny protein cylinders called microtubules generate moments of conscious experience.
Max Tegmark and other critics proved that warm, wet brain tissue destroys delicate quantum states in mere femtoseconds through thermal noise.
Surgical anesthetics target standard protein ion-channels like GABAA receptors rather than altering quantum vibrations, as proven by precise genetic knock-in mice.
